page.help: A second Discord server that banned members can still join. They ask for their ban to be lifted (appeal) there, because they cannot reach your main server. The invite link to it is set on Enforcement & appeals.

title: Support server
notConnected: No support server is connected yet. The bot owner has to set one up first.
bannedRoleHelp: Members who are banned from the main server get this role in the support server. Mewvo takes it away when the ban ends.
cannotSee: Mewvo cannot see the support server right now, so its roles cannot be listed. Check that Mewvo is a member there.
appealsCategoryHelp: A category is a folder of channels. Each ban or kick appeal gets a channel here where the member can talk to staff. Staff decide in a staff-only channel in the main server. Not set: appeals open staff-only in the main server.
invite: Invite link sent to banned members: {invite}. You can {change}.
notConnectedOther: No support server is connected here: a second server for banned members (banned role, appeal channels) is only for Mewvo’s own servers for now. Your support server invite above is what members are sent.

yourInvite.title: Your support server invite
yourInvite.cardHelp: Punishment and quarantine DMs tell members to join this server to talk things out.
yourInvite.label: Your support server invite
yourInvite.help: A permanent invite to your own support server (discord.gg/…). It is the same setting as “Your appeal invite” on Enforcement & appeals. Empty: the DMs have no invite line.
yourInvite.helpHome: Mewvo’s Support server: the invite punishment and quarantine DMs name. Also on Enforcement & appeals → Channels.
yourInvite.mewvoNote: Your members are sent to Mewvo’s support server for now, not this invite. You can change that under {link}.
yourInvite.bad: That is not a Discord invite link (https://discord.gg/…).
yourInvite.required: The support server invite cannot be empty here.
